title: Experience Stunning Views of Lake Michigan and the Chicago Skyline From Above w/ Tandem Skydive Jump for 1 to 4
merchant_name: Skydive Windy City - Michigan City, IN
description:
Highlights
USPA-certified Instruction
: Customers enjoy a secure and professional skydiving experience with highly qualified instructors.
Soar from 14,000 Feet
: Experience the unparalleled thrill of
freefalling from 14,000 feet
, creating unforgettable memories.
Panoramic Chicago Skyline Views
: Revel in
epic views of the Chicago Skyline
and Lake Michigan's stunning shore during the jump.
Adrenaline-Pumping Adventure
: Fulfill a bucket list dream with an
exhilarating skydiving adventure
that truly gets the heart racing.

What To Expect
Prepare for an unparalleled adventure as customers ascend over a mile above
Lake Michigan's pristine shore
. With the guidance of a
USPA-certified instructor
, they will feel the anticipation build, leading up to the incredible moment of a tandem skydive from
14,000 feet
. This is their chance to leave worries behind and embrace the freedom of the open sky, witnessing the world from a truly unique perspective.
Once the jump begins, customers will experience an
adrenaline surge
during an exhilarating freefall, feeling the wind rush past them at incredible speeds. As the parachute deploys, they will glide gracefully, taking in
breathtaking, epic views of the Chicago Skyline
stretching majestically along the horizon. This tandem skydive provides an ultimate thrill and a
bucket-list-worthy experience
, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

Plan Your Visit
Operating Hours
Open Daily from 8am to 6pm
Duration
You should anticipate spending about 3 hours with them for your tandem skydive
Parking
Ample parking available inside facility
Accessibility
This place is wheelchair accessible. Please reach out to them directly to inquire about these jumps

How It Works
1. Grab the Deal
Buy your Groupon first!
2. Plan your Visit
Follow the link on your Groupon to select the date.
3. Redeem your Mobile Ticket
Scan your Groupon upon arrival.
4. Enjoy the Experience!

fine_print: 3 day hassle-free refund guarantee- Free cancellation for up to 3 days after purchase for unredeemed vouchers.
Valid daily, subject to availability based on online appointment bookings.
$39 payment per jumper required at time of reservation.
Deposit refunded when checking into facility for appointment.
Must sign online waiver at least 24 hours prior to appointment to avoid $10 extra fee.
Additional $40 fee applies to anyone from 210 pounds to 250 pounds.
All customers must be under the maximum weight for their height as per height/weight chart.
Must bring a government-issued picture ID (passport, driver's license, or state ID).
Must bring Groupon voucher code, either printed out or on your phone.
